svg.text: Norsk Data ND-500 in one cabinet, model 11
ND-520, ND-540, ND-505/CX, ND-510/CX and ND-500/CX Model 21 | 169 x 60 x 91 cm
ND-500 backwiring A, B, C, D
ND-500 backwiring A, B, C, D
Cutaway: left side panel, front cover plates and the front of the roof removed. Heights from the nutclip hole numbers in ND Book 2 chapter 12; outer size from the ND-520/540 product sheets.
The ND-500 crate's position and which face its cards use are read from one isometric (drawing 20489) and are not certain. Sources: ND-B2C12.pdf; NEC-01 ND-500 course card sheets.
Colour: dark brown, from the ND-560 brochure photograph; the exact paint is not documented.
